Q: Overriding python threading.Thread.run() A:

I think the general idea when you subclass an existing class is to preserve its machinery the most, so you can use what is already implemented in it. To stand in the shoulders of giants, as Newton said.

In this case it means you should keep the signature -- the number and the type of the parameters -- of the run() method, that you will override.

That is, the additional information you want to pass to the run() method, should be passed by other means. If it's just one time you need to pass the information, you can pass it in the constructor of your class, aka the __init__() method.

The Threading class reference documentation is very enlightening and you may find great information there.

Q: Powershell script doesn't finish with no error or output when run as admin A:

Why do this, this way?

Why not just use GPP for the monitor the services, let GPP settings take action on the services and send you an alert via script. Just curious and an idea to consider.

Try something like this...

#Services to Monitor
$ServiceToMon = 'MSSQLSERVER' #define service name here
$voicesrv="voiceserv" #define voice server here

#Email Params
$From = "alert@alert.com"
        $To = "support@domain.com"
        $SMTPServer = "smtp"
        $Body = "Start the Servicve if Found stopped $status "
        $Subject = " Service Status for  $($env:computername) "

#Start services that are stopped
Get-Service -computername $voicesrv $ServiceToMon  | 
where {$_.Status -eq 'Stopped'}  | 
Start-Service $ServiceToMon
timeout /t 10

$status = get-service $ServiceToMon
send-mailmessage -from $from -to $to -subject $Subject -smtpserver $SMTPServer -body $Body

Q: Non-deprecated way of using normal sized adaptive banner with AdMob SDK V13 A:

I was facing the same issue, and found that the new getPortraitInlineAdaptiveBannerAdSize (or getCurrentOrientationInlineAdaptiveBannerAdSize) produced more sensible sizes, and while using it for an anchored banner is probably not their recommended use case it seems to be a viable workaround (the response from Google in this thread also suggested using these, or just setting a fixed size).

val adSize = AdSize.getPortraitInlineAdaptiveBannerAdSize(context, screenWidthDp)

or

val adSize = AdSize.getCurrentOrientationInlineAdaptiveBannerAdSize(context, screenWidthDp)

or

val adSize = AdSize(AdSize.FULL_WIDTH, AdSize.AUTO_HEIGHT)

or

val adSize = AdSize.BANNER

Q: Is it possible to uninstall or update the "Microsoft SQL Server 2019 Setup" program that is installed by SQL Server independently? A:

I was able to fix similar issue. I noticed Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management displaying the SSMS client is outdated. However impacted machine had two different SQL verion. One of the version was installed in C:\SQL2022\ path. I wasn't able to uninstall and encounter the same behavior that you have reported. So I managed to install an app for the package from below link for SSMS 2022 version.

Downloaded the KB from Microsoft Update catalog and version got auto updated. However its best to know how to uninstall the conflicting version.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/sql/releases/sqlserver-2022/build-versions

Q: AzureException: HTTPSConnectionPool : Max retries exceeded with url A:

If you look at the error: AzureException: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='account_name.blob.core.windows.net', port=443):

This means any of following:

  1. Your URL is HTTP and not HTTPS
  2. Your account name is not fully qualified: It should be http(s)://server ip or name/accountname
  3. You are using emulator and not specifying in the connection something as follows: blob_service=BlockBlobService(account_name=STORAGEACCOUNTNAME,account_key=STORAGEACCOUNTKEY, is_emulated=True, protocol='http')
